flags.problem: Key and only accepted answer 'It was very fun.' is non-standard model English ('very fun'); parallel items A-6/B-6 use 'very good'/'very funny'.
flags.fix: Change prompt and key to '...after lunch. It was a lot of fun.' or 'It was very nice.'

flags.problem: 'This road is very tall' reverses the Arabic tawil transfer (Arabic-L1 learners say 'long' for tall, as in A-5), so the error is not a realistic Arabic-L1 error; forms not equal in what they test.
flags.fix: Use a tall/long error in the L1 direction, e.g. 'That building is very long, it has 40 floors.' -> 'tall', or a kabir error ('My sister is bigger than me, she is 20' -> older).

flags.problem: 'drinks eggs' is not a documented Arabic-L1 eat/drink transfer; the real one is 'drink soup' (and 'drink a cigarette'), which Arabic expresses with shariba.
flags.fix: Use 'My grandfather drinks soup every night.' -> 'eats/has soup'.

flags.problem: l1ErrorType spelling_consonant_f_v: Arabic lacks /v/, so the expected error is v->f ('fery', 'elefen'); writing v for f ('fivteen', also B-6 'fivty') is hypercorrection and much less typical.
flags.fix: Use a v->f error, e.g. 'The bus comes at seven' misspelt 'sefen', or 'elefen' -> 'eleven'; apply the same to B-6.

flags.problem: 'I keep my pens in my notebook' is not clearly wrong (pens can be kept in a notebook), so the item does not reliably target a lexical error; A-5/C-5 have unambiguous wrong objects.
flags.fix: Use an unambiguous mismatch, e.g. 'I sharpen my pencil with my ruler.' -> 'sharpener'.

flags.problem: l1ErrorType 'copula_omission/noun_for_adj' is wrong: the sentence has the copula ('it is rain'); the error is noun for adjective/verb only.

Every target outcome in outcomes.json still has condition 'Gap-fill or choice items, no help...', but the criterion and the forms include error correction, free production (0/1/2) and transfer items, so condition and criterion disagree.
flags.fix: Update the outcome condition to e.g. 'Delayed form of 9 items: controlled, error correction, free sentence and transfer; no help; items not seen in lessons'.
